card.architecture: Deterministic OKLab/DIN99d palette + grid quantizer over a batch of stills (no model) — LoadImage×N → ImageBatch → PixelQuantizeFP → SaveImage
card.summary: Pixel-quantizes N still frames together, deriving ONE global fp palette + label frequencies across the whole set (temporally consistent — no frame-to-frame flicker) and emitting the per-frame lossless sprites. The images-in sibling of pixel-quantize-video: same fp math over the same batched IMAGE tensor, but fed the frames directly (source + reference images) with no video encode/decode. No model, no VRAM. API-only — submitted by id with the frames as the edit source + references.
use_cases: derive the shared pixel-art palette for a set of animation frames without round-tripping through a video
batch-pixelize exploded frames in the sprite export pipeline
card.pick_when: You have a set of still frames and want them pixel-quantized against one shared derived palette.
